content: Python is a high-level programming language used for web development, automation, data science and artificial intelligence.
Java is an object-oriented programming language widely used for enterprise applications and Android development.
C is a low-level programming language that provides direct memory access and is commonly used for operating systems.
JavaScript is a programming language used to create interactive web pages and dynamic user interfaces.
Object-oriented programming organizes software into objects containing data and methods.
A compiler translates source code written in a programming language into machine code.
Artificial intelligence enables machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence.
Machine learning is a branch of artificial intelligence that allows computers to learn patterns from data.
Deep learning uses artificial neural networks with multiple layers to solve complex problems.
Natural language processing enables computers to understand and generate human language.
A neural network is a computational model inspired by the structure of the human brain.
Computer vision allows machines to interpret and analyze images and videos.
A computer network connects multiple devices to exchange information and share resources.
TCP IP is a communication protocol suite used to connect devices across the internet.
HTTP is a protocol used for communication between web browsers and web servers.
DNS translates domain names into IP addresses.
A router forwards data packets between different computer networks.
Cybersecurity protects computer systems and networks against attacks and unauthorized access.
A relational database stores structured data in tables containing rows and columns.
SQL is a language used to create, retrieve, update and delete data in relational databases.
Database normalization reduces data redundancy and improves data consistency.
NoSQL databases store data using flexible structures such as documents and key-value pairs.
An index improves database query performance by reducing the number of records scanned.
A binary search tree is a data structure that organizes values using left and right child nodes.
A sorting algorithm arranges elements in a specific order such as ascending or descending order.
A graph consists of vertices and edges representing relationships between objects.
Dijkstra algorithm finds the shortest path from a source vertex to other vertices in a weighted graph.
A hash table stores key-value pairs and uses a hash function to calculate storage positions.
Time complexity describes how the execution time of an algorithm grows with input size.
A recursive algorithm solves a problem by calling itself on smaller instances of the same problem.
